name: PHINIA Inc.
summary: PHINIA Inc. engages in the development, design, and manufacture of integrated components and systems. The company operates through Fuel Systems and Aftermarket segments. The Fuel Systems segment provides advanced fuel injection systems, including pumps, injectors, fuel rail assemblies, and engine control modules; fuel delivery modules; canisters; sensors; and electronic control modules. This segment also offers complete systems comprising software and calibration services that reduce emissions and enhance fuel economy for traditional and hybrid applications.
